reuse.why: Extends the existing getScheduleAmount helper and reuses getApproxNumberThreshold from shared/rules for the 7.5% tolerance instead of recomputing it.

duplication.why: The approximate rule is written once inside getScheduleAmount; call sites only pass their operator.

placement.why: The amount rule stays in shared/schedules.ts where ranged worst-case already lives; server and preview code only forward the op.

scope.why: Only the four existing getScheduleAmount call sites, the helper and a test change.

maintainability.why: Clear single definition; the optional untyped amountOp string means a future caller that forgets to pass it silently gets the exact value, so a typed op would be safer.

bypasses_abstraction.where: All schedule-amount resolution (forecast, updateActions, postTransactionForSchedule, preview transactions) goes through getScheduleAmount.

disguised_duplication.where: No duplicated logic; the threshold comes from the shared getApproxNumberThreshold.

one_place.where: getScheduleAmount in packages/loot-core/src/shared/schedules.ts, now taking the amount op, used by forecast-schedules.ts, schedules/app.ts (two sites) and computeSchedulePreviewTransactions.
